name: City of Flagler Beach
rules: Special-event itinerant merchant paperwork has carried a $25 fee.
Prepared-food vendors must provide the applicable state food-service license.
Food vendors have been required to provide a $1,000,000 certificate of insurance naming the city as additional insured.
Special-event paperwork should be submitted ahead of the event; current city checklist has specified at least 10 business days.
caution: Verify the current form and insurance wording for the exact event before paying or sending a COI.

name: City of Palm Coast
rules: Palm Coast has a separate mobile-food-vendor site / certificate-of-use framework for ordinary approved MFDV sites.
The city has published a $116 MFDV site permit in its mobile-food-vendor materials.
An ordinary site permit is not the same thing as acceptance into a city special event.
Event-specific vendor packets can separately require DBPR license, COI and organizer acceptance.
caution: Do not combine ordinary park/site vending rules with special-event permission. Confirm the exact route for the date.

name: St. Johns County
rules: County park or recreation presence does not itself establish a right to vend.
Food-truck requirements can be controlled by the event organizer, venue and state MFDV licensing together.
Generator, fire and insurance requirements vary by event.
caution: Use the event application as the primary commercial source, then confirm venue-specific requirements.
